answer: Each submission hangs on the onyx of a task receipt, and the umber is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, forfeited on duplicate submission. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
